title: Isolation of Nuclei from Adult Mouse Brain Tissue Protocol
author: Allen Institute for Brain Science
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bq7emzje
materials: Isolation of Nuclei from Adult Mouse Brain Tissue
2 M Potassium Chloride, RNase free (KCl; Ambion/Thermo Fisher Scientific AM9640G)
1 M Magnesium Chloride, RNase free (MgCl2; Ambion/Thermo Fisher Scientific AM9530G)
1 M Tris Buffer, pH 8.0 (Ambion/Thermo Fisher Scientific AM9856)
Triton X-100 (Molecular biology grade, Sigma T8787)
Molecular Biology Grade Ethanol (Sigma E7023 or equivalent)
Millimark mouse anti-NeuN monoclonal antibody clone A60, PE conjugated (EMD Millipore FCMAB317PE)
anti-SATB2 rabbit monoclonal antibody, Alexa Fluor 647 conjugated (Abcam EPNCIR130A)
PE mouse IgG1k isotype control (BD Biosciences, 550617)
Bottle-top vacuum filter system; 0.22 µm pore size, 250 ml (EMD Millipore SCGPU02RE, Millipore Steritop or equivalent) or 0.45 µm (Corning 430516 purchased as VWR 28199-814, 28199-818 or equivalent)
Syringe filter, 0.22 µm (EMD Millipore, Millex PES 30 mm sterile syringe filters, SLGP033RB or equivalent)
30 ml syringe, luer lock (Becton Dickinson BD309650)
Tube rotator (Miltenyi MACS Mini or equivalent)

steps.title: Prepare 10% BSA Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a 10% BSA solution in nuclease-free water.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 g Ultrapure, RNase-free BSA to a 50 ml conical tube.
Add 20 ml of Nuclease-free water using a serological pipette.
Vortex until BSA powder is fully dissolved.
Allow solution to sit at room temperature for 20 minutes to reduce foaming.
Filter through a 0.22 µm syringe filter into a clean 50 ml conical tube.
Store at 4°C for up to two weeks.

steps.title: Prepare 10% Triton X-100 Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a 10% Triton X-100 solution in nuclease-free water.

substeps.instruction: Measure 18 ml of Nuclease-free water into a 50 ml conical tube.
Add 2 ml of Triton X-100.
Vortex until fully dissolved.
Allow solution to sit at room temperature for 20 minutes to reduce foaming.
Filter through a 0.22 µm syringe filter into a clean 50 ml conical tube.
Store at 4°C for up to 30 days.

steps.title: Prepare Nuclei Isolation Media (NIM)
steps.instruction: Prepare 250 ml of Nuclei Isolation Media (NIM) pH 8.0.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 200 ml of Nuclease-free water into an RNase free 250 ml bottle.
Add 2.5 ml 1 M Tris Buffer, pH 8.0 (final concentration 10 mM).
Add 21.45 g Sucrose (final concentration 250 mM).
Add 3.13 ml of 2 M KCl (final concentration 25 mM).
Add 1.25 ml of 1 M MgCl2 (final concentration 5 mM).
Shake until sucrose is fully dissolved.
Adjust final volume to 250 ml with Nuclease-free water.
Filter using a 0.22 µm (Millipore Steritop) or 0.45 µm (Corning) filter system attached via Tygon tubing to a 1000 ml filter flask and vacuum pump.
Store at 4°C for up to two weeks.

steps.title: Prepare Protease Inhibitor Cocktail Solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 50X Protease Inhibitor Cocktail in ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Remove 50X Protease Inhibitor Cocktail from -20°C freezer.
Immediately add 1 ml of molecular biology grade 100% Ethanol using a P1000 pipette.
Pipette up and down 5-10 times to dissolve.
Transfer to a PCR grade 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Store at 4°C for up to 30 days.

steps.title: Prepare DAPI Stock and Working Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1 mg/ml DAPI stock and a 0.1 mg/ml working solution.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 10 mg of DAPI in 10 ml of Nuclease free water (1 mg/ml stock).
Divide into 1 ml aliquots in 1.5 ml RNase free microcentrifuge tubes and freeze at -20ºC for up to six months.
At time of use, thaw an aliquot and dilute 1:10 in nuclease-free water (e.g., 100 µl stock to 900 µl water) to a final concentration of 0.1 mg/ml.
Store 0.1 mg/ml DAPI at 4°C for up to 1 month; 1 mg/ml stock can be stored at 4°C for up to 3 months or returned to -20°C.

steps.title: Prepare Blocking Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare fresh blocking buffer on the day of use and store on ice or at 4°C.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 8.2 ml of Nuclease-free water into a 15 ml conical tube.
Add 1 ml of 10X PBS, pH 7.4.
Add 0.8 ml (800 µl) of 10% BSA in nuclease-free water (final concentration 0.8%).
Vortex briefly to mix.
Add 50 µl of 40 U/µl RNasin Plus RNAse inhibitor (final concentration 0.5%, 0.2 U/µl).
Invert 5-10 times to mix (do not vortex after adding RNase inhibitor).

steps.title: Prepare Homogenization Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare fresh homogenization buffer on the day of use and store on ice or at 4ºC.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 24.125 ml of Nuclei Isolation Media (NIM) pH 8.0 into a 50 ml conical tube.
Add 25 µl of 100 mM DTT stock (final concentration 0.1 mM).
Add 500 µl 50X Protease inhibitor cocktail (final concentration 1X).
Add 125 µl 40 U/µl RNAsin Plus (final concentration 0.5%, 0.2 U/µl).
Add 250 µl 10% Triton X-100 in Nuclease-free Water (final concentration 0.1%).
Mix by inverting the tube 5-10 times (do not vortex after adding RNasin Plus).

steps.title: Prepare Dounce Homogenizers
steps.instruction: Sterilize and cool Dounce homogenizers prior to use.

substeps.instruction: Soak homogenizers in RNAse Away solution overnight.
Rinse thoroughly with MilliQ water, followed by one final rinse with nuclease-free water.
Dry on a clean kimwipe.
Wrap body and pestles in clean kimwipes, place in a clean secondary container, and cool at 4°C for at least 30 minutes.

steps.title: Microdissect Regions of Interest (ROI)
steps.instruction: Isolate ROI from acute adult mouse brain tissue slices (200-500 µm thick).

substeps.instruction: Cover the bottom of a Sylgard-coated dissecting dish with ACSF.I (RP0218) using a P1000 pipette.
Place tissue slice in the dish and transfer to a fluorescent dissecting microscope.
Dissect ROI, leaving them in the cutout section, and separate them from the rest of the tissue.
Aspirate ROI cutouts and ~30 µl of ACSF using a P1000 pipette with a modified (cut-off) tip and dispense into a 1.5 ml Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube.
Repeat for the desired number of slices.

steps.title: Freeze and Thaw Samples
steps.instruction: Flash freeze samples or prepare for homogenization.

substeps.instruction: Create a slurry of dry ice and ~200 ml of 200 proof Ethyl alcohol in a small ice bucket.
Aspirate as much ACSF.I as possible from sample tubes.
Hold sample tubes in slurry for 30-60 seconds (until visibly frozen) and keep on dry ice.
If samples were frozen: add 1 ml homogenization buffer to each tube and place on wet ice to thaw.
If not frozen: remove remaining ACSF.I and add 1 ml homogenization buffer; keep on wet ice.

steps.title: Homogenize Tissue
steps.instruction: Mechanically disrupt tissue using Dounce homogenizers.

substeps.instruction: Place the Dounce body in an ice bucket with wet ice (prevent ice from entering the top).
Transfer tissue and homogenization buffer to the Dounce.
Homogenize with 10 strokes of the 'loose' pestle, keeping the pestle submerged to avoid bubbles.
Remove loose pestle, check sides for stuck tissue (rinse back with ~200 µl homogenization buffer), and insert the 'tight' pestle.
Homogenize with ~10 strokes of the tight pestle while keeping the Dounce on ice.

steps.title: Filter and Pellet Nuclei
steps.instruction: Remove debris and concentrate nuclei via centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Add an additional 2 ml of homogenization buffer to the Dounce (total volume 3 ml per sample).
Transfer homogenate through a 30 µm cell strainer into a 15 ml conical tube.
Centrifuge at 4°C for 10 min at 900 x g.
Remove supernatant, leaving approximately 50 µl above the pellet.

steps.title: Resuspend and Block Nuclei
steps.instruction: Resuspend nuclei in blocking buffer and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µl of blocking buffer to the pellet.
Resuspend by gently pipetting up and down 5 times.
Incubate on ice for up to 15 minutes.
Transfer to a 1.5 ml RNase-free microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Quality Control (Optional)
steps.instruction: Assess nuclei quality and yield using Trypan Blue.

substeps.instruction: Mix 10 µl of nuclei resuspension with 10 µl of 0.4% Trypan Blue.
Incubate for 1 minute at RT.
Pipette 10 µl into a disposable hemocytometer and examine under an inverted phase-contrast microscope.

steps.title: Stain Nuclei with Antibodies
steps.instruction: Label nuclei using specific antibodies and isotype controls.

substeps.instruction: Prepare control tubes: remove a small amount of resuspension (e.g., 50 µl) from high-yield samples and add 450 µl blocking buffer (total 500 µl).
DAPI Control: Set one control tube aside on ice.
Isotype Control: Add PE conjugated IgG1k to a control tube at 1:250 dilution (e.g., 2 µl for 500 µl). If using AF647 antibodies, also add AF647 conjugated IgG1k at 1:250.
Experimental Samples: Add Millimark mouse anti-NeuN PE conjugated antibody at 1:500 dilution (e.g., 1 µl for 500 µl).
Incubate all tubes on a tube rotator in a 4°C refrigerator for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Wash and Finalize for FACS
steps.instruction: Wash nuclei and prepare for fluorescence-activated cell sorting.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge all samples at 4°C, 400 x g for 5 minutes using a swinging bucket rotor.
Remove supernatant, leaving ~50 µl, and add 500 µl of clean blocking buffer.
Resuspend by gently pipetting up and down 5 times.
Add DAPI to a final concentration of 0.1 µg/ml (from 0.1 mg/ml stock) and mix by tapping.
Filter each sample through the cap of a 5 ml Polystyrene round bottom FACS tube.
Keep tubes on ice or at 4°C until FACS.

steps.title: Cleanup and Disposal
steps.instruction: Dispose of waste and clean equipment.

substeps.instruction: Dispose of unused blocking and homogenization buffers down the sink.
Dispose of all tissue and contaminated material via the Biohazardous Waste stream.
Clean Dounce homogenizers with tap water, soak overnight in RNase Away, rinse with MilliQ water, then nuclease-free water.
Dry with kimwipes, wrap in kimwipes, and store in an RNase-free box or Ziploc bag at room temperature.
